tests.title: GHL → Integration page shows org-shared connection (connected)
steps: Open the web app at http://avantej.localhost:3021 and sign in as franchisee@gmail.com (admin of Test Fitness Franchise)
Navigate to GHL Integration via the sidebar Settings → GHL Integration link (/go-highlevel-integration)
Confirm the 'Organization-Wide GHL Connection' card shows a green '✓ Connected' badge
Confirm the connected location id reads 'G0izzPbelobw04MIntR1', country fields = 38, and a 'Connected at' timestamp is shown
Confirm the 'Branch Connections' table renders (incl. the connected 'Tenant Test Fitness Franchise Branch' → G0izzPbelobw04MIntR1) and the 'Sync Events' card is present

tests.title: GHL → Inbound webhook creates a client (shows as processed in Sync Events)
steps: Setup (off-camera): throwaway branch-link 'avantej-e2e-inbound-loc' bound to the org (Bukit Jalil branch); a signed phone-only ContactCreate webhook for unique contact 'e2e-ghl-202140' POSTed to /webhooks/gohighlevel/avantej-e2e-inbound-loc — server resolved the tenant, verified the signature (sha256(secret.body)), ran processGhlWebhook → HTTP 200 status:processed
Open GHL Integration (/go-highlevel-integration) signed in as franchisee@gmail.com and scroll to the 'Sync Events' card
Confirm the newest event row shows a 'processed' badge for the inbound contact ghl-e2e-ghl-202140@ghl.placeholder at 2026-06-22 12:21:41
Expand the event row — raw payload confirms type 'ContactCreate', contact id 'e2e-ghl-202140', firstName 'E2E', lastName 'GHLInbound', locationId 'avantej-e2e-inbound-loc'
Teardown (off-camera): sync event, member, customer profile, contact-link, placeholder user deleted and the throwaway link deactivated

tests.title: GHL → Outbound: create customer pushes a real GHL contact
steps: Sign in as franchisee@gmail.com; Dashboard → Create Customer
Enter ZZ TestCust-GHL, phone +60120009901, branch Bukit Jalil; Create Profile
Customer is created and appears in the directory (active, unclaimed)

Verify on the GHL side via API read-back: GET /contacts/wbu0GqWrCtV1t7rYiPUV returned firstName 'ZZ', lastName 'TestCust-GHL', tag 'customer:active', locationId G0izzPbelobw04MIntR1 — confirmed in the LIVE MOVE Private Fitness GHL account
Required a code fix: the Quick-Add (createUnclaimed) path did not fire GHL sync; wired fireCustomerSync(create) so customer-create now pushes a contact
Teardown (off-camera): real GHL contact deleted + Avantej test customer removed

tests.title: GHL → Outbound: edit customer updates the real GHL contact
steps: Open the ZZ TestCust-GHL profile (Customers → directory)
Set Address = 'ZZ Test Address E2E' and click Save Profile (customerProfiles.upsertForCustomer → fireCustomerSync update)
Verify on the GHL side via API read-back: GET /contacts/wbu0GqWrCtV1t7rYiPUV now returns address1 'ZZ Test Address E2E' on the same contact — confirmed in the LIVE GHL account
Teardown (off-camera): real GHL contact deleted + Avantej test customer removed

tests.title: GHL → Outbound: delete customer removes the real GHL contact
steps: Setup (off-camera): throwaway customer ZZ DelTest-GHL (+60120009902) created — pushes a real GHL contact Sok77wuvLFSc4FACI6uD — then seeded claimed so soft-delete is permitted (unclaimed profiles are blocked by design)
Open the ZZ DelTest-GHL profile and click Delete → confirm
softDelete succeeds (HTTP 200) and fires fireCustomerSync(operation:delete) → DELETE /contacts/<id>
Verify on the GHL side via API read-back: GET /contacts/Sok77wuvLFSc4FACI6uD now returns 400 (gone); Avantej contact-link status = 'deleted' — confirmed against the LIVE GHL account
Teardown (off-camera): Avantej test customer removed

tests.title: GHL → Outbound: new staff (invite→accept) creates a real GHL user
steps: Setup (off-camera): a pending trainer invitation is seeded for mock email zz-staff-<ts>@example.com (branch Bukit Jalil)
Open the public accept-invitation page (signed out) — shows 'You've Been Invited!' with the invited email + role
Fill name + password, click 'Sign Up & Accept Invitation' → invitations.acceptWithSignup → dispatchStaffSync(create) using GHL_AGENCY_ID
Verify on the GHL side via API read-back: GET /users/BuF0op0nmLfeKdPcFJP9 returned name 'ZZ StaffTest-GHL', email zz-staff-<ts>@example.com — a real user in the LIVE GHL location
Teardown (off-camera): real GHL user deleted (GET → 404) + Avantej user/member/link/invitation removed

tests.title: GHL → STAGING web: create customer → real GHL contact (live screencast)
steps: Open the STAGING web app (avantej-core-web.ngchwanlii-a9c.workers.dev) + sign in as franchisee@gmail.com — verifies the web→server CORS fix (was pointing at the old developer-avantej account)
Dashboard → Create Customer → ZZ StgWeb-GHL, +60120009908, branch Bukit Jalil → Create Profile
Toast 'Customer profile created' — staging server createUnclaimed → fireCustomerSync(create)

Verify on the GHL side via API read-back: GET /contacts/Fq87vqBR3pFsq6yewz31 returned firstName 'ZZ', lastName 'StgWeb-GHL', tag 'customer:active' — a REAL contact in the live GHL account, end-to-end through STAGING
Teardown (off-camera): real GHL contact deleted + Avantej test customer removed

tests.title: GHL → Inbound: bad signature rejected (401, no record)
steps: Off-camera: POST to the staging real-location webhook with an invalid x-wh-signature
Server returns HTTP 401 'Invalid webhook signature' (code invalid_signature) — verified
Staging GHL Integration → Sync Events shows a 'failed' row, reason 'Invalid webhook signature', contact 'unknown' — no client created
Proves the verifyGhlWebhookAuth gate rejects unsigned/forged webhooks

tests.title: GHL → Inbound: duplicate event is deduped (idempotency)
steps: Off-camera: signed ContactCreate for a unique contact → processed (client created)
Off-camera: a second signed webhook for the same contact + event type
Staging GHL Integration → Sync Events shows the first 'processed' and the duplicate 'skipped' (Duplicate event skipped) — deduped by (location, contact, eventType)
Proves inbound idempotency: a re-delivered webhook does not double-create the client
Teardown (off-camera): sync events + client removed

tests.title: GHL → Outbound: staff updates (role / branch / deactivate) sync to GHL user
steps: Seed mock CP user → members.create (staff) → real GHL user (ghlUserId 5K3u…, synced)
C2 updateRole(trainer) → dispatchStaffSync(update) → ghlSync synced (PUT /users/:id)
C4 updateScope(new branch) → dispatchStaffSync(update) → ghlSync synced
C3 deactivate → ghlSync SKIPPED (reason 'deactivate-skip') — FINDING: deactivation does not touch the GHL user by design
C5 profile-name edit → same dispatchProfileSync→PUT path (not triggerable standalone w/ a non-platform-admin session; proven by C2/C4)
Teardown: GHL user deleted (404) + all Avantej rows removed

tests.title: GHL → Outbound: customer sync retry recovers a failed contact
steps: Create throwaway customer (real GHL contact + active link), seed contact-link sync_status = 'error'
customerProfiles.retryGhlSync(org, customerProfileId) → ghlSync 'synced'
Verify: link sync_status error → active; real GHL contact intact
Teardown: customer + GHL contact removed

tests.title: GHL → Branch: bulk retry of failed syncs recovers errored contacts
steps: Branch (active GHL link) has a contact-link sync_status = 'error'
ghl.retryFailedSyncs(org, tenantBranchId) → { attempted: 1, recovered: 1, stillFailing: 0 }
Verify: errored link flips back to active (re-pushed to GHL)
Teardown: test customer + GHL contact removed; throwaway link deactivated
